title: 15.14. Hetuduka, Hīnattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuṁ hīnaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu nahīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ majjhimaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā nanahetu namajjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Hetuṁ paṇītaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu napaṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
